programme.title: A8 - Abenteuer Autobahn
programme.desc: For the fourth time we will have the opportunity to take a closer look at German expressways.The creators of the program take us to the A8 motorway.The 505-kilometer route starts in Perl, passes through Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Augsburg and Munich, reaching all the way to the border with Austria.This road is one of the most important East-West connections in Central Europe.We will be able to see the work of the police, truck drivers, highway maintenance services, and engineers whose task is to smooth traffic.
